title: Python analyzer: attribute and subscript assignment targets must not rebind their base name (DEC-303 (a23) item 1)
description: FileWalker.addTargetBindingsAsRebound (src/python/calls.ts) and addTargetBindings recurse into attribute and subscript assignment targets and record the base identifier as rebound, so self.x = v makes self multiply bound and self.m() unresolved; d['k'] = v rebinds d. Python binds no name through an attribute or subscript target. Conformance bug per DEC-303 (a23) item 1. May land on dev; must NOT reach glyph-cli main until the operator has run the glyph 0.1.0 publish and visibility scripts (main and v0.1.0 at dad914a). Review spot-checks a sample of newly resolved sites. test/python-gate stays fenced.

acceptanceCriteria.text: fixtures written from Python semantics go red before the fix and green after: self.x = v then self.m() resolves; d[k] = v then d.keys() is not unresolved by rebinding; x.a, x.b = 1, 2 then x.m() resolves
a bare-name, starred or tuple-of-names target still binds as before (negative fixtures stay green)
the full test suite, typecheck, lint and format check pass
the analyzer version constant is bumped so cached Python indexes are rebuilt
review spot-checks a sample of newly resolved sites on a development repository and records the verdict
the change is on dev only and is not promoted to main before the operator confirms the 0.1.0 publish and visibility scripts have run

plan: 1. Add red fixtures in test/python-calls.test.ts from Python semantics
2. Fix addTargetBindings and addTargetBindingsAsRebound to skip attribute/subscript targets
4. Tracker commit with task, PR for review
implementationNotes: Red then green: commit 1 adds 5 fixtures (4 red on dev: self.x = v, self.a, self.b = ..., k[0] = 2 on a known-class local, for self.i in xs; plus a negative fixture that bare-name, tuple-of-names, starred and for-target rebinding still bind, green throughout). Fix: addTargetBindings and addTargetBindingsAsRebound return without recording a name for attribute and subscript targets. PYTHON_ANALYZER_VERSION 2 -> 3 so cached indexes rebuild. Full suite 718 pass, typecheck, lint, format:check green. Scratch measurement on five development repos (not committed): 297 calls leave needs-inference (flask 42 unresolved sites cleared, jinja 118, httpx 34, rich 58, tqdm 39 by the diag diff; some move to resolved-external, not in-repo), sample for the reviewer: flask app.py:1054 self.finalize_request, jinja compiler.py:935 self.pull_dependencies, httpx _models.py:959 self.close, rich table.py:953 table.add_row, tqdm std.py:1446 self.refresh. Not for main until the operator has run the 0.1.0 publish and visibility scripts (DEC-303 (a23) item 1).
